chatDescription: Ask questions and get excerpts from published help guides.
chatIntro: Ask a question and I’ll look for relevant published guides. Don’t include passwords or sensitive information.
chatPrivacy: Your question, recent chat messages, and relevant guide excerpts are sent to Anthropic to generate an answer.
chatSearching: Searching guides and preparing an answer…
chatDraftLabel: Review and edit your support message
chatDraftPrivacy: This draft is not sent automatically. Remove passwords, tokens, and other sensitive information before opening your email app.
chatError: Couldn't get an answer. Please try again.
chatRateLimited: Help chat is busy or has reached its daily limit. Please try again later or contact support.
shareDescription: Send this link to a teammate. It opens this guide in the same language.
linkHint: You can also select the link and copy it manually.
copiedDescription: Ready to paste into a message or email.
copyFailedDescription: Your browser blocked clipboard access. Select the link above and copy it manually.
helpfulnessPrivacy: We save your vote and optional reason on the server with a hashed browser identifier. A 30-day cookie lets you update your vote; it does not contain your feedback. This form does not ask for your name or email and does not create a support request.
helpfulnessDemo: Demo feedback is stored on this preview server and marked separately from production feedback. It does not update published guides.
helpfulnessReason: If not, what could we improve? (optional)
helpfulnessThanks: Thank you—your feedback has been saved.
helpfulnessPreviouslySaved: Your previous feedback is selected. You can change it and send an update.

helpfulnessErrors.invalid: Choose Yes or Not quite, then try again.
helpfulnessErrors.forbidden: We could not verify this submission. Reload this page and try again.
helpfulnessErrors.tooLarge: This submission is too large. Reload this page and try again.
helpfulnessErrors.rateLimited: You have sent several updates. Please wait a minute before trying again.
helpfulnessErrors.unavailable: Feedback could not be saved. Please try again later.
helpfulnessErrors.notFound: This article is no longer available for feedback. Please reload the page.
